entries.text: DataFusion and GizmoSQL now receive query results as Arrow inside the query timer and record fetch_mode per query; set the fetch_mode platform option to rows to switch back.
details: Rows and Arrow produced identical result digests for all 22 TPC-H queries at scale factor 0.01 on both platforms.
ClickHouse local mode (chDB) gains an Arrow path behind fetch_mode=arrow and stays on rows by default: its rows path returns NaN where the Arrow path returns NULL for an empty aggregate.
InfluxDB FlightSQL results are converted to Python rows column by column.
